description: This Java class 'HelloController' is a REST controller in a Spring Boot application. It provides several public endpoints including a welcome message, health checks, documentation redirect, and application info, primarily for interfacing and diagnostics purposes.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing welcome, health, documentation, and info endpoints for a Spring Boot backend application.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message string for root access.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to Swagger UI documentation page, preserving original request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a simple health check endpoint returning 'OK'.

methods.name: apiHealth
methods.description: Returns application health status as a JSON payload with status 'UP'.
